name: aerospace-rwa
description: Aerospace RWA — the aerospace asset financial network. Tokenization, compliance, investment and settlement infrastructure on Stellar + Soroban.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,investor,issuer,admin,ops,api -c cyan,blue,magenta,yellow,green,gray "npm run dev -w @aerospace/web" "npm run dev -w @aerospace/investor-portal" "npm run dev -w @aerospace/issuer-portal" "npm run dev -w @aerospace/admin-portal" "npm run dev -w @aerospace/operations-portal" "npm run dev -w @aerospace/api"
scripts.build: npm run build:apps && npm run build:services
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @aerospace/web && npm run build -w @aerospace/investor-portal && npm run build -w @aerospace/issuer-portal && npm run build -w @aerospace/admin-portal && npm run build -w @aerospace/operations-portal
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:contracts
